request.text: There is a rust-red container against the south wall, behind the nano-fab yard. The family who fitted it out went with a Kara-veen caravan last season. Bunk, a steel locker, shelves, a window that shuts. Forty credits takes the lease off the roll and the key is yours. Keep the locker for your salvage; the Berms will fill your pack faster than you think.
